name: Anjana & Devadev
quote: From the mandap to the sadya, everything was flawless. Our guests still talk about the food and the stage décor — FD Events made our day feel like a dream.

name: Afrah & Aslam
quote: The Islamic counter and the mappilappattu team made our reception unforgettable. Every detail was handled with so much care and grace.

name: Thomas Mathew
